_comment: Rotational (slump) Monte Carlo parameters. Units: m, s, kg/m^3, degrees.

d0._comment: Target initial depth (positive, in meters) used to place the slump center / start point.

L._comment: Slump length along-slope (m). (For areas this is the synthetic 1D profile length).

T._comment: Slump thickness proxy (m). mode='ratio' means T = tl * L_eff, clipped to [min_m,max_m].

strength._comment: Undrained strength proxy controls for rotational stability model.

su_ratio._comment: Dimensionless undrained strength ratio used by kcrit_rotational().

ru._comment: Pore-pressure ratio model for rotational: 'direct' or 'grilli'.
ru._comment2: If using grilli model, these matter; clipping always applies.

width._comment: Width used only for volumes/maps: w = U(w_min,w_max) * L_eff

hazard._comment: Return-period ramp used to query k(RP) from hazard-fit NPZ. Units: years.

placement._comment: Same spirit as translational: keep areas+transects consistent and avoid far mismatches.
